recipe.title: Chicken and spinach tikka masala
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Nadia Lim's Fresh Start Cookbook.

i.n: chicken thighs, boneless, skinless, diced 2 cm

method.s: Heat oil in a chef's pan over medium heat. Cook onion for 6-8 minutes until soft and starting to turn golden brown.
Add spices, garlic, ginger, lemon zest and salt, and continue cooking for a further 1-2 minutes. (If any starts to catch, add 1-2 Tbs water and stir to lift.)
Add chicken, tomatoes, sweet chili sauce, lemon juice and cream. Cover and simmer for 5-10 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir through spinach until wilted, and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve with fresh coriander and Greek yoghurt.
